name: Ahilyanagar (Ahmednagar)
summary: Historic fortress district, sugar cooperative capital, home to Shirdi Sai Baba Temple and Shani Shingnapur.

profile.Food: Jowar bhakri, Pithla, Shirdi Prasad laddu

points: Shirdi is the sacred spiritual sanctuary of 19th-century saint Sai Baba
Ahmednagar Fort was constructed in 1490 CE by Malik Ahmad Nizam Shah I

name: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad)
summary: Tourism Capital of Maharashtra, world-renowned gateway to Ajanta and Ellora UNESCO rock cave temples.

profile.Crafts: GI-tagged Paithani silk sarees, Himroo shawls, Bidriware

points: Ellora Cave 16 (Kailasa Temple) is the largest monolithic rock-cut structure on Earth
Bibi Ka Maqbara constructed in 1660 CE is known as the 'Taj of the Deccan'

name: Kolhapur
summary: Historic royal Maratha capital on the Panchganga River, famed for Mahalakshmi Temple, wrestling, and leather footwear.

profile.Food: Kolhapuri Tambda Rassa, Pandhra Rassa, Kolhapuri Misal
profile.Crafts: GI-tagged Kolhapuri chappals (leather sandals), Kolhapuri Saaj jewelry

points: Mahalakshmi (Ambabai) Temple is an ancient 7th-century Chalukyan Shakti shrine
Revered center of traditional Indian Kushti wrestling at historic talims

name: Mumbai City
summary: Financial and entertainment capital of India, island city of Gateway of India, Dalal Street, and Bollywood.

profile.Food: Vada Pav, Pav Bhaji, Bombay Duck, Bhel Puri

points: Gateway of India erected in 1924 overlooking the Arabian Sea
Victorian Gothic and Art Deco Ensembles of Mumbai inscribed as UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2018

name: Mumbai Suburban
summary: Metropolitan suburban territory housing Sanjay Gandhi National Park, Kanheri Buddhist Caves, and film studios.
points: Sanjay Gandhi National Park is one of the world's few major protected forests inside city limits
Kanheri Caves feature 109 rock-cut Buddhist chaityas and viharas (1st century BCE–10th century CE)

name: Nagpur
summary: Orange City and Winter Capital of Maharashtra, geographical center of India marked by the Zero Mile Stone.

profile.Food: Tarri Poha, Saoji Mutton, Nagpur Orange barfi

points: Zero Mile Stone erected by British Great Trigonometrical Survey of India in 1907
Deekshabhoomi is where Dr. B. R. Ambedkar embraced Buddhism with 600,000 followers on 14 October 1956

name: Nashik
summary: Wine Capital of India on the Godavari river, sacred Kumbh Mela city, home to Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga.

profile.Food: Misal Pav, Poha, Table grapes, Wine
profile.Crafts: GI-tagged Nashik Valley Wine, Silver jewellery

points: Trimbakeshwar Temple houses one of the 12 sacred Jyotirlingas with three-faced lingam (Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva)
Hosts the monumental Simhastha Kumbh Mela once every 12 years along the Ramkund ghats

name: Pune
summary: Oxford of the East and cultural capital of Maharashtra, seat of the Peshwas, automotive and IT metropolis.
points: Shaniwar Wada was the historic seven-story fortified palace seat of the Maratha Peshwas built in 1732 CE
Aga Khan Palace served as prison for Mahatma Gandhi and Kasturba Gandhi during the Quit India movement

name: Solapur
summary: Textile and pilgrimage center, home to Siddheshwar Temple and sacred Vithoba sanctuary at Pandharpur.

profile.Crafts: GI-tagged Solapur Chaddar (jacquard bedsheets) and Terry Towels

points: Pandharpur Vithoba Temple is the spiritual focal point of Maharashtra's historic Varkari Bhakti movement
Largest producer of jacquard bedsheets and terry towels in India
